name: null-device-id
description:
REGRESSION LOCK. Two devices whose id is present but null. str(device.get('id', '')) turned null into the literal string 'None' -- the .get default only applies when the key is ABSENT -- so both records imported as ONE foreign id, and every id-less device in the estate collided onto a single runZero asset carrying the union of their hostnames, addresses and vulnerabilities. That same 'None' was interpolated into the vulnerability URL, so the run issued POST .../devices/None/vulnerabilities/_search against an endpoint that cannot exist. Both records must now be skipped with a log line, no request may be made for device 'None', and the healthy device must still import.

Skips namespaced_ids: the foreign id is the bare Carbon Black device number with no organization_key scope, a separate defect recorded with the malformed scenario.

log_contains: carbon-black: skipped 2 devices with no id
